body_lead: The Odisha government will host the Regional AI Impact Conference, scheduled to be held from December 19 to 20, setting the tone for a major national-level dialogue on artificial intelligence in governance and public service delivery. The state Electronics and IT Department on Wednesday held the curtain raiser for the conference, providing an early glimpse into Odisha’s AI vision, policy direction, and its growing portfolio of real-world AI deployments.
